description: List the payments registered on one invoice, with paging. Fees and currency differences are listed by bokio_list_invoice_settlements.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

name: bokio_list_invoice_payments
